mapper.select: SELECT oi.id, oi.order_id, oi.product_id, oi.sku_id, oi.product_name, oi.sku_spec, oi.main_image, oi.price, oi.quantity, oi.subtotal, oi.create_time, ps.sku_code AS sku_code FROM mo_order_item oi LEFT JOIN mo_product_sku ps ON ps.id = oi.sku_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY oi.id ASC
SELECT product_id AS productId, COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(subtotal), 0) AS revenue FROM mo_order_item WHERE create_time >= #{since} GROUP BY product_id
